## Welfare Experiment: Difference in Means and OLS

Loads the welfare survey experiment and estimates the wording effect by difference in means and OLS.

```{webr}
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
# Read in data
data <- read.csv("data/welfare-small.csv")
n <- nrow(data)

# The difference-in-means estimator
Y=data$Y
D=data$D
tau_dm=mean(Y[D==1])-mean(Y[D==0])

# The least-squares estimator
model=lm(Y~D)
coeftest(model,vcov=vcovHC(model,type='HC2'))
```

## Covariate-Adjusted Welfare Estimate

Reestimates the welfare wording effect after adding six observed covariates.

```{webr}
# Regress Y on D and W
model1=lm(Y~D+age+polviews+income+educ+marital+sex,data)
coeftest(model1,vcov=vcovHC(model1,type='HC2'))
```

## Fully Interacted Welfare Estimate

Centers the six covariates and fits a treatment-by-covariate interacted regression.

```{webr}
covariates <- c("age", "polviews", "income", "educ", "marital", "sex")
data_centered <- data
data_centered[covariates] <- lapply(data[covariates], function(x) x - mean(x))
model_interacted <- lm(
  Y~D*(age+polviews+income+educ+marital+sex),
  data=data_centered
)
coeftest(model_interacted,vcov=vcovHC(model_interacted,type='HC2'))
```

## Monte Carlo: Difference in Means versus Adjustment

Simulates 100 samples and compares the means and variances of unadjusted and covariate-adjusted estimates.

```{webr}
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
# Fix sample size = 1000
n=1000

# 100 simulation replications
B=100

# for replication
set.seed(5280)

# Store the estimates
tau_dm=0
tau_ols=0

# Loop over all simulated samples
for (b in 1:B){
		w=rnorm(n,2,1) # create W; here the mean is not 0
		e=rnorm(n,0,1) # create the error term
		d=(rnorm(n,0,1)>0) # create a binary treatment
		y=1+d+w^2*d+exp(w)+e # true model. W does not enter the model linearly
		model1=lm(y~d) # dm estimator
		tau_dm[b]=model1$coefficients[2]
		model2=lm(y~d+w) # regression adjustment
		tau_ols[b]=model2$coefficients[2]
}
# examine the mean and variance
mean(tau_dm)
mean(tau_ols)
var(tau_dm)
var(tau_ols)
```

## Monte Carlo: Fully Interacted Adjustment

Repeats the simulation with centered treatment-by-covariate interactions and reports the estimate's mean and variance.

```{webr}
# Added fully interacted regression adjustment
set.seed(5280)
tau_interacted=0

for (b in 1:B){
		w=rnorm(n,2,1)
		e=rnorm(n,0,1)
		d=(rnorm(n,0,1)>0)
		y=1+d+w^2*d+exp(w)+e
		w_centered=w-mean(w)
		model3=lm(y~d*w_centered)
		tau_interacted[b]=model3$coefficients[2]
}
mean(tau_interacted)
var(tau_interacted)
```
